Asif Ali Zardari [ a ] (born 26 July 1955) is a Pakistani politician who has served as the 14th president of Pakistan since 2024. A member of the Pakistan People's Party , he served as the 11th executive president from 2008 to 2013. He is the first Pakistani head of state born after the country's independence and is also known for being the widower of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto .
